T: Bouncer on the door. Snacks on the bar.
D: A professional bar cooler is hired to clean up the roughest roadhouse in Missouri.
P: Serve the snacks when Dalton takes over the Double Deuce.
S: Wings dried overnight and baked until crisp, tossed in hot sauce butter, served with a chunky blue cheese dip and cold celery sticks. Leave 1kg chicken wings uncovered in the fridge overnight, then toss with 1 tbsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 100ml hot sauce. Mash 100g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Toss the hot wings in the sauce and serve with the dip and celery sticks.
Jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked

Halved jalapeños packed with cream cheese, cheddar and smoked paprika, wrapped in streaky bacon and baked until crisp, with a cool ranch dip. Halve 12 jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds. Beat 200g cream cheese with 60g grated cheddar and half a tsp smoked paprika and pack into the halves. Wrap each in half a rasher of streaky bacon and pin with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp. Mix 150g sour cream with chopped chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for a dip.
Dill and garlic pickled baby cucumbers served with sharp cheddar
Cucumbers packed into jars with garlic, dill and peppercorns in a hot vinegar brine, pickled a week, with sharp cheddar.
M: Paprika-rubbed pork ribs baked slow and glazed with molasses tomato sauce
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar, garlic and cayenne, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with a tomato and molasses barbecue sauce under the grill.
the town doctor who stitches Dalton up

Rump steak seared hard in cast iron and basted with garlic thyme butter, with a baked potato loaded with sour cream, bacon and chives, and a green salad. Rub 4 large potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200C for 1 hour. Season 4 rump steaks and sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 3 minutes. Flip, add 50g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for 3 minutes for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes. Split the potatoes and top with sour cream, crisp bacon and chives. Serve with a green salad dressed in oil and vinegar.
W: Buttery yellow cake topped with a sweet cream cheese layer
A St Louis classic: cake base under a rich, gooey butter and cream cheese layer, dusted with icing sugar.
K: Bourbon, lime and bitters topped with cold ginger beer

Bourbon poured over ice with fresh lime and a dash of bitters, topped with spicy ginger beer and finished with a lime wedge. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Pour 45ml bourbon into each and squeeze in a lime wedge. Add a dash of aromatic bitters to each glass. Top with 150ml cold ginger beer and give it one gentle stir. Garnish with a fresh lime wedge and serve straight away while the band plays.

veg.n: Double Deuce smoky eggplant jalapeño poppers
veg.make_ahead: Cook the eggplant strips and fill the jalapenos up to 1 day ahead, chilled; wrap, pin and bake on the night

ingredients.item: small eggplants, sliced lengthways very thin

steps.text: Halve the jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds.
Beat the cream cheese with cheddar and a third of the paprika and pack into the halves.
Cut the eggplant into 24 strips, brush with the oil, maple syrup and remaining paprika and cook in a hot pan until soft.
Wrap each jalapeno half in a strip of eggplant and pin with a toothpick.
Bake on a rack at 200C until the eggplant is crisp at the edges.
Mix the sour cream with chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for a dip.

dishes.make_ahead: Pickle a week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Pack the cucumbers into a jar with garlic, dill and peppercorns.
Boil the vinegar with the water and salt and pour over.
Pickle for a week in the fridge.
Serve with sliced cheddar.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the ribs up to 1 day ahead and keep wrapped in the fridge; bake and glaze on the night

steps.text: Rub the ribs with paprika, brown sugar, crushed garlic and cayenne.
Wrap in foil.
Bake at 150C until tender.
Simmer the tomato sauce with molasses.
Unwrap, brush on the glaze and glaze under the grill.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the corn into ribs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; rub, roast and glaze on the night

steps.text: Cut each corn cob in half crossways, then carefully quarter each piece lengthways with a heavy knife.
Rub with the oil, paprika, brown sugar, crushed garlic, cayenne and salt.
Roast at 220C on a lined tray until curled and golden.
Simmer the tomato sauce with the molasses.
Brush on the glaze and glaze under the grill.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake and cool the cake up to 1 day ahead, covered; dust with icing sugar just before serving

steps.text: Mix the cake mix with an egg and melted butter and press into a 20 by 30cm tin.
Beat the cream cheese, remaining eggs, vanilla and most of the icing sugar.
Pour over the base and bake at 175C.
Cool.
Dust with icing sugar.

dishes.make_ahead: Cut the lime wedges up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; build each drink over ice on the night

steps.text: Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Pour bourbon into each and squeeze in a lime wedge.
Add a dash of bitters to each glass.
Top with ginger beer, stir gently once and garnish with a fresh lime wedge.

af.n: Double Deuce black tea and ginger
af.make_ahead: Steep and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build each drink over ice on the night

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Pour the cold tea into each and squeeze in a lime wedge.
Add a drop of vanilla extract to each glass.
Top with ginger beer, stir gently once and garnish with a fresh lime wedge.

s.how: Halve 12 jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds. Beat 200g cream cheese with 60g grated cheddar and half a tsp smoked paprika and pack into the halves. s.note: Dill and garlic pickled baby cucumbers served with sharp cheddar
s.how: Pack 500g small cucumbers into a jar with 2 garlic cloves, dill and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over 250ml hot white vinegar boiled with 250ml water and 1 tbsp salt. Pickle a week. Serve with 200g sharp cheddar.

m.note: Paprika-rubbed pork ribs baked slow and glazed with molasses tomato sauce
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, garlic and a pinch of cayenne. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Simmer 150ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp molasses, brush on and glaze under the grill.

w.note: Buttery yellow cake topped with a sweet cream cheese layer
w.how: Mix 250g butter cake mix with 1 egg and 60g melted butter and press into a 20 by 30cm tin. Beat 250g cream cheese, 2 eggs, 1 tsp vanilla and 300g icing sugar, pour over and bake at 175C for 40 minutes. Cool and dust with icing sugar.
